name: giant-salamander-skillbox
description: Review tables and citations, plan study size, and draft medical costs.

interface.longDescription: Giant Salamander Skillbox combines readatable for reconstructing statistical tables, reviewcitation for checking citations and public bibliographic records when host web access is available, and samplesize200 for validated sample-size, event, power, and detectable-effect calculations. It also includes draftcostsheet for traceable medical-cost sheets using authoritative unit-cost sources when host web access is available. No separate gestimation account or authentication is required, and user content is not sent to a gestimation-operated server.
defaultPrompt: Use readatable to reconstruct this statistical table while preserving headers, units, sample sizes, and footnotes.
Use reviewcitation to reconcile in-text citations with the reference list and flag items needing verification.
Use samplesize200 for study size or draftcostsheet for a source-linked medical-cost sheet.
